name: Worker focused development replication
selection_rule: Fixed structural selection: two medium and two hard multi-part repository tasks. Selection follows prior outcomes and is explicitly development reuse; no unseen-generalization claim. No replacement or best-run selection.

tasks.selection_reason: The same async related-manager API spans ordinary/reverse managers and generic relations; partial fixes can omit a manager family.

omission_categories.requirement: Async create/get_or_create/update_or_create on ordinary and reverse related managers
Async create/get_or_create/update_or_create on generic related managers

tasks.selection_reason: The original issue names str, pretty and LaTeX output for MatrixSymbol subtraction; consistent behavior spans printer implementations.

omission_categories.requirement: String rendering represents MatrixSymbol subtraction correctly
omission_categories.coverage_note: P2P string regression; not an independent full requirement oracle.

omission_categories.requirement: Pretty rendering represents MatrixSymbol subtraction correctly
omission_categories.coverage_note: P2P pretty regression only; the historical parser collapses same-named MatrixElement tests across printers, so those F2P names cannot be attributed to a printer. Manual/output diagnostic evidence is required for requirement coverage.

omission_categories.requirement: LaTeX rendering represents MatrixSymbol subtraction correctly
omission_categories.coverage_note: P2P LaTeX regression; not an independent full requirement oracle.

tasks.selection_reason: Author resolution priority and query-backend ILIKE behavior are separable concerns with a shared integration contract.

omission_categories.requirement: Name, alternate-name and surname priority with birth/death-year disambiguation
Case-insensitive matching, wildcard query semantics and unmatched candidate preservation
